title: The Zscaler Python SDK against ZIA: where its behavior is described

prose.text: This walks the subjects that describe how the Python SDK calls ZIA. Which module and method reaches which API path is generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <module or method>`.

prose.label: The client.
prose.text: Authentication is in [[zia.sdk-python.authentication]], what calls return in [[zia.sdk-python.response-shape]], errors and accessor names in [[zia.sdk-python.client-errors-and-accessors]], and when a session ends in [[zia.sdk-python.activation-and-session]].

prose.label: Requests.
prose.text: How requests are built, paged and retried is in [[zia.sdk-python.request-conventions]] and [[zia.sdk-python.pagination]]. Which services each SDK covers is in [[zia.api.sdk-coverage]].
